description: The global names a code can reach, as the type-checker declares them (archi/01-product.md, 'What exists in the sandbox'). The isolate's globals must be exactly ecmascript + sandbox, plus httpAction when the action set enables the http action. A change here goes with a new determinism epoch.

absent.Buffer: There is no Buffer: use TextEncoder and TextDecoder for text, atob and btoa for base64, and Uint8Array for bytes.
absent.fetch: fetch exists only when the action set enables the http action, and only for the hosts it allows. Call the actions of "rewind:actions" instead.
absent.process: There is no process and no environment: pass values through the run's input, the argument of main.
absent.require: Scripts are ES modules: import { … } from "rewind:actions", "rewind:workflows" or "rewind". Nothing else can be imported.
